svg.text: Logged predictor with drag penalty held fixed, replacing vertical velocity from the barometer slope
Coast start: logged 2870.8 ft, vz-only 3119.2 ft, alt+vz 3124.7 ft
First settling: logged 2742.1 ft, vz-only 2933.7 ft, alt+vz 2939.2 ft
State apogee: logged 2677.7 ft, vz-only 2685.9 ft, alt+vz 2849.1 ft
Final coast sample: vz-only uplift 8.1 ft, alt+vz uplift 171.3 ft
Baro velocity is a centered 0.30 s regression slope. This is a counterfactual isolating vz and state altitude, not a re-run of the full flight computer.
